name: Queen of Yarrow
source:
Leaving her home country, Marten Princess Maeve has arrived in the kingdom of Yarrow to marry The Frog King Cyrus III. But when the king refuses to leave his room, the new queen must adapt to ruling a kingdom alone.

Queen of Yarrow is just a glimpse of what a full game could be. 

This game takes place in the same universe as the Petunias Journey games, but you do not need to play anything else to enjoy it.

[from [url=https://carnalmantrap.itch.io/queen-of-yarrow]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
马丁公主梅芙离开祖国，抵达亚罗王国，与青蛙王赛勒斯三世结婚。但当国王拒绝离开他的房间时，新王后必须适应独自统治一个王国。

《蓍草女王》只是完整游戏的冰山一角。

该游戏与《Petunias Journey》游戏发生在同一个宇宙中，但你无需玩任何其他游戏即可享受它。

[来自[url=https://carnalmantrap.itch.io/queen-of-yarrow]Itch.io[/url]]
